title: Compactly supported C¹ antiderivative of a zero-mean continuous function
statement: Let a, b be reals and g : ℝ → ℝ continuous with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ (a, b) and ∫_ℝ g(x) dx = 0. Then there is Φ : ℝ → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support, tsupport Φ ⊆ (a, b), and deriv Φ = g (equality of functions).
lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ x, g x = 0 → ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ ∧ HasCompactSupport Φ ∧ tsupport Φ ⊆ Ioo a b ∧ deriv Φ = g
